{{Top|leg}}
'''Chith''' was a [[General/Legends|general]] in the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. In [[2 ABY/Legends|2 ABY]], Chith oversaw [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa's]] mission to a conclave of rebel sympathizers on [[Kiamurr]]. Upon discovering from the arriving [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] of an impending Imperial attack, Chith was responsible for devising an evacuation plan from the planet.
